# Enbox UX programme design

Synthesised from design 1 (winner by the implementability judge) with every graft the three judges asked for, every mustFix, and every factual correction verified against the code (path:line below refer to the current tree; LiveKit facts verified against `livekit/livekit` `config-sample.yaml`, `pkg/config/config.go`, `pkg/service/server.go`, the webhooks and ports docs and the `livekit-server-sdk` README). Revised after the verifier pass: every refuted claim (C3, C9, C10) was re-checked against the code and corrected below, and every "fix" note attached to a confirmed claim was applied; the list of changes is in the final section.

## Decisions

D1. **Space channels are `chats` rows with NEW types `'space_text' | 'space_voice'`** (direction 1, map 35 Option A). `chats_type_ck` (apps/server/src/db/schema.ts:313) becomes the superset; `chats_space_ck: (space_id is not null) = (type in space types)`. Types `channel` (anonymised at apps/server/src/services/messages.ts:490 (reply previews), 686, 704, 727, 735) and `group` (groups pipelines) are never reused. The three compile-forced sites (`chatKindOf` packages/shared/src/utils.ts:73-76, `chatKindOfRow` apps/server/src/services/chats.ts:157-159, the exhaustive switch in apps/server/src/services/system.ts:35-49) plus the runtime throws in apps/server/src/services/membership.ts:104,177-178,230 are the guard. `computeChatPermissions` (utils.ts:109-170) is NOT compile-forced (a new type falls through to the group block at :153-169 and would get `DEFAULT_GROUP_SETTINGS` = everything allowed), hence the explicit first branch in D3. The ~49 silent sites (map 35) are swept with shared predicates (`isSpaceChatType`, `hasReceipts` (direct|group), `showsSenders` (t !== 'channel'), `inChatList` (not space), see Shared contracts); the sweep list is explicit so nothing is left to memory: server messages.ts:186,194,236-251,263-266,280-292 (insertMessage), :490 (toPreview), :546,686,704,727,735 (toMessages), :588/:634 (named reaction/voter queries skipped for channels), :911 (messageUpdatedPayloads); watermarks.ts:120, :307, :620, :633, :703; summaries.ts:111, :218, :234; chats.ts:320; membership.ts:123, :128, :230, :267; web stores/chats.ts:449 (groups filter), :464-465, :523, :534-540; MessageRow.tsx:179; Composer.tsx:195, :206, :636 (`aria-autocomplete`); features/chats/links.ts:24-31; realtime/messages.ts:152; ChatRow.tsx:54,61; MessageSearchResults.tsx:62.

D2. **Access is materialised**: one `chat_members` row per (space channel, member with VIEW_CHANNEL) so `getChatAccess` (chats.ts:381-411), `visibleTo`/`memberVisibleSql` (chats.ts:209-234), `visibleChatIds` (apps/server/src/realtime/io.ts:18-30), `unreadCounts` (apps/server/src/services/watermarks.ts:385-409) and rooms keep working. Rows: role `member`, `joined_seq 0`, marks `= last_seq`. Today `activate` (membership.ts:98-169) gives `joined_seq 0` only for `change.initial || chat.type === 'channel'` (:122-127) and `marks = last_seq` only for `channel` (:128, written at :141-142), so a space type would silently take the group rule: both conditions become `chat.type === 'channel' || isSpaceChatType(chat.type)`. Removal is a new `revoke` kind in `MembershipChange` (:40-69) mirroring `unfollow` (:224-241: row deleted, `fx.removeChat`, `member.left` with a new reason `'revoked'` next to `'left' | 'removed' | 'unfollowed'` at apps/server/src/services/events.ts:35); `deactivate` keeps throwing for non-groups (:177-178). Bulk grants/revokes from `syncChannelAccess` use set-based writes (see Performance) and then emit the same per-pair effects/domain events so hooks (voice) run. Space channels take the channel-like fast path in `insertMessage` (messages.ts:186-294) with named senders, are excluded from the no-`chatIds` list in `toChatSummaries` (apps/server/src/services/summaries.ts:69-96, where clause :81-86 has no type predicate today) ONLY — `toChatSummary`/`GET /api/chats/:chatId` (summaries.ts:99-106), `chatSummariesForPairs` (summaries.ts:40-62, used by `fx.chatUpsert` via effects.ts:357) and `chatPreviews` (apps/server/src/modules/chats/service.ts:568-580, search/starred) keep serving them (mustFix: `useChats.refreshChat` on unknown-chat `message:new`, apps/web/src/realtime/messages.ts:167-169, and ConversationPane.tsx:84-90 depend on it).

D3. **Permissions** are a 31-flag int4 bitfield (ADMINISTRATOR = bit 30; bit 31 never used) evaluated by pure shared helpers with Discord's exact algorithm (channel-scope overwrites only; category overwrites are templates copied on create / "sync"). `ChatSummary.spacePermissions` is server-computed per viewer AND client-recomputable from viewer-neutral `Space.roles` + `ChatSummary.overwrites` + `Space.me.roleIds` (graft from design 1): a role/overwrite edit costs one room broadcast, never members×channels `chat:upsert`s. Precise cost of the rejected alternative: `fx.chatUpsert` → `chatSummariesForPairs` → `buildSummaries` runs a FIXED number of batched statements (≈ 15, summaries.ts:5-8), but the lateral last-message subquery (:155-164) and `unreadCounts` (:174-177, watermarks.ts:385-409) are evaluated once per (chat, viewer) pair inside those statements — O(members × channels) lateral evaluations per edit, not round trips, and still far too much for a 2 000 × 100 space. Bits map into the unchanged `ChatPermissions` booleans through a new first branch of `computeChatPermissions` (utils.ts:109-170).

D4. **Voice = self-hosted LiveKit v1.13.7** (native systemd binary, same host; pin ≥ 1.13.7, where `TURNServer.secret/secret_file/ttl` are confirmed to exist), signalling proxied same-origin under `/livekit/` on all three domains; media on `rtc.udp_port: 7882-7892` (a UDP **mux** range — LiveKit's config-sample documents `udp_port` as "all UDP traffic goes through listed port(s)" and accepts `7882-7892`; `rtc.port_range_start/end` MUST stay unset because the two are an if/else-if in which the port range wins) + `rtc.tcp_port: 7881`; `rtc.turn_servers[]` with `secret: ${TURN_SECRET}` + `ttl` (LiveKit's `TURNServer` struct: "dynamic credentials are generated using HMAC-SHA1") so no static coturn credential is minted by deploy.sh. `voice_states` (PK `user_id`) is DB truth, kept by a raw-body webhook + a reconciliation job; the mesh engine stays for 1:1/group calls.

D5. **Rollout of Spaces**: P1 and P2 deploy alone; P3a (server) + P3b (web) ship in ONE deploy whose boot AWAITS the community→space conversion in apps/server/src/index.ts between `initDb` (line 13) and `createApp` (line 14) — `startJobs` (index.ts:17) fires `runOnStart` with `void tick()` (apps/server/src/jobs/index.ts:39, errors only logged at :34) and `server.listen` follows immediately (index.ts:19-21), so a job can neither gate readiness nor abort boot. While the conversion runs the process is not listening, so the deploy's health check (`GET /api/health` → `{ok, version}`, apps/server/src/modules/system/routes.ts:8-10 — the only health endpoint) fails until it finishes: the host deploy script must wait up to 10 min for this release. NOTE: no deploy script is tracked in the repo today (`git ls-files` shows only `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml`); `/opt/enbox/deploy.sh` exists only on the host, so it is vendored into `deploy/deploy.sh` in P3a S4 (not P3c) and its health-check wait, backup and rollback become reviewable code. Gated by `SPACES_MIGRATE=on|dry|off`; forward-fix-only once the first community commits; `pg_dump` immediately before; the communities routes stay mounted one release (empty), the Communities UI is replaced, tables drop in 0005 behind a `DO $$ … RAISE $$` zero-row guard (P3d).

D6. **Direction 6 kept**: `autoplayAnimatedMedia` and `reduceMotion` are device-local `DevicePrefs` in apps/web/src/stores/ui.ts (DEFAULT_PREFS merge at ui.ts:197-206 needs no migration); per-chat theme/wallpaper are per-viewer `chat_members` columns synced by `PATCH /chats/:id/prefs` → `chat:upsert` (apps/server/src/modules/chats/service.ts:172-216, `fx.chatUpsert(me, chatId)` at :213 fires only for a non-empty patch).

D7. **Presence naming**: `availability` (choice), `PresenceState` (wire), `presenceNote`; routes `/api/me/presence`, `/api/me/presence-note`; never "status" (stories). The note travels on `presence:update` + `me:updated` only — never `user:changed`. Reason, stated precisely: `PATCH /me` registers `meUpdatedEffect` + `userChangedEffect` whenever the patch changes ANY field (apps/server/src/modules/users/routes.ts:167-174; nothing is emitted for unchanged/omitted fields, :131), and `user:changed` reaches every direct/group room I am in plus everyone who saved me (fanout.ts:28-51); each receiving client refetches me via a batched `POST /users/batch` — only if it already has me cached (apps/web/src/realtime/users.ts:20-23 → stores/users.ts:164-169 early return, batch at :81). A note edited several times a day through `PATCH /me` would therefore fan a refetch to every co-member's cached copy; a dedicated route that registers only `presenceEffect` + `meUpdatedEffect` costs one `presence:update` per subscribed socket instead.

D8. **Migration privacy** (graft from design 2, refined with `chat_members.left_reason`): converted rows keep their `joined_seq`; community members who were never in a linked group get a row with `joined_seq = chat.last_seq` (future only; matches membership.ts:122-128 and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:606-608, where community members may join linked groups later "unless removed from it by an admin", :608). Former members are distinguished by `left_reason` (`'left' | 'removed'`, schema.ts:349, always set with `left_at`, CHECK :378-381): `'left'` rows are deleted and replaced by a future-only row like never-members; `'removed'` rows are deleted AND the channel gets a member overwrite `deny VIEW_CHANNEL` for that user (no `chat_members` row), so the 608 exception survives the conversion and a moderator can lift it later. No per-group hidden roles.

D9. Kept from the judges' grafts: `voice:speaking` relay (sidebar rings for non-participants), `server_mute/server_deaf` on `space_members`, `voice:join {takeover}`, `connected_at` reaper, webhook event-id dedupe + session cross-check, 503 `voice_unavailable`, DB-backed slowmode (`chat_members.last_sent_at`), default `#general` + `General` voice channel on create/migration, `PUSH_SPACE_ALL_CAP`, legacy `community_*` SystemEvent kinds kept render-only (utils.ts:418,464,466), `registerRoomSource` before `counted = true` (io.ts:136), scrub nulls `chat_members.theme/wallpaper_media_id`, community AND group invite codes converted to `space_invites`. Corrected graft: mesh/voice mutual exclusion is a per-user advisory **busy lock taken after every row lock of the path** plus an exported combined busy check (`services/busy.ts`), not a bare export of `joinedCallId` — see Voice → Join for the lock facts.

D10. Out of scope (P4, hooks reserved): threads, custom emoji, multi-reactions, E2EE, multi-instance. Per-space member avatars are deferred with them (nickname ships).

## Data model (all phases, with migration files)

All migrations are generated with `npm run db:generate` (apps/server/drizzle.config.ts, `casing: 'snake_case'`), appended to apps/server/drizzle/meta/_journal.json (one entry `0000_init`, `when: 1790328673116`, today), never editing 0000_init.sql. The migrator selects pending migrations by `Number(lastDbMigration.created_at) < migration.folderMillis` (node_modules/drizzle-orm/pg-core/dialect.js:62), so every appended entry needs a journal `when` greater than 1790328673116 (db:generate stamps `Date.now()`; hand-edited journals must respect it). It runs every pending migration and its bookkeeping insert inside ONE transaction (dialect.js:60-71; node-postgres BEGIN/COMMIT on one pooled client, PGlite `client.transaction`), so `chats_type_ck` DROP+ADD is atomic (design 0's "briefly unconstrained" risk is moot). Conventions: `text().$type<Union>()` + CHECK (no pgEnum), `uuid().defaultRandom()`, `ts()` = timestamptz(3) (schema.ts:54-55), media FKs `ON DELETE SET NULL` + partial index (schema.ts:89-91 pattern), every media FK added to the GC `NOT EXISTS` list (apps/server/src/jobs/mediaGc.ts:32-36, five entries today).

### 0001_profiles.sql (P1)

- `users` (schema.ts:61-93): `banner_media_id uuid → media SET NULL` + `users_banner_idx … where not null`; `pronouns text`; `bio text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` (`about`, schema.ts:71, stays the one-line WhatsApp status); `profile_color text`, `accent_color text` with CHECK `col is null or col ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$'`; `availability text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online' CHECK in ('online','idle','dnd','invisible')` (no such column exists today — the invisible invariants below depend on it); `availability_until timestamptz(3)` + partial index; `presence_note_text text`, `presence_note_emoji text`, `presence_note_expires_at timestamptz(3)` + partial index. Columns (not `users.settings` jsonb, schema.ts:76) because the disconnect `last_seen_at` write must be able to carry a row predicate (`… and availability <> 'invisible'`, io.ts:106-109) and the expiry job needs indexes.
- `media` (schema.ts:180-209): `animated boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`, `frame_count integer`, `metadata_stripped boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false`; `width/height` (193-194) become server-verified for images.
- `scrubDeletedUser` (apps/server/src/services/users.ts:523-551) nulls every new column and resets `availability='online'`. GC list gains `users.banner_media_id`.

### 0002_chat_themes.sql (P2)

- `chat_members` (schema.ts:328-384, prefs 357-363): `theme jsonb` (ChatTheme; enums + lowercase hex only, zod-validated), `wallpaper_media_id uuid → media SET NULL` + partial index. Rejoin keeps prefs (membership.ts:145-163); unfollow deletes the row (membership.ts:235-237) so channel themes are lost on unfollow (documented). GC list gains `chat_members.wallpaper_media_id`; scrub sets `theme=null, wallpaper_media_id=null` on the deleted user's rows (they survive soft delete, account.ts:46-157).

### 0003_spaces.sql (P3a)

New tables:

- `spaces`: id, name (≤ SPACE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH 100), description (≤ 2048), icon_media_id → media SET NULL (+idx), banner_media_id → media SET NULL (+idx), owner_id → users NOT NULL, created_by SET NULL, system_channel_id → chats SET NULL (circular, nullable like communities.announcement_chat_id schema.ts:230-232), rules_channel_id, afk_channel_id → chats SET NULL, afk_timeout_sec int DEFAULT 300, default_notify_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mentions' CHECK in ('all','mentions'), is_discoverable bool DEFAULT false, vanity_code text UNIQUE NULL (shares the invite code space), legacy_community_id uuid UNIQUE NULL (conversion idempotency key), created_at, updated_at.
- `space_members`: PK(space_id cascade, user_id cascade), nickname text (≤ NICKNAME_MAX_LENGTH 32), joined_at, timed_out_until timestamptz(3), server_mute bool DEFAULT false, server_deaf bool DEFAULT false, notify_level text NULL CHECK in ('all','mentions','none'), muted_until timestamptz(3), suppress_everyone bool DEFAULT false; index (user_id); index (space_id, joined_at, user_id) (member paging cursor).
- `space_roles`: id, space_id cascade, name (≤ 100), color text (hex CHECK), position int NOT NULL (0 = @everyone), permissions integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (bits 0-30 only), hoist bool, mentionable bool, is_default bool DEFAULT false, created_at; partial unique `space_roles_default_uq (space_id) where is_default`; unique (space_id, position).
- `space_member_roles`: PK(space_id, user_id, role_id); FK (space_id,user_id) → space_members cascade; role_id → space_roles cascade; index (role_id). @everyone is implicit.
- `space_categories`: id, space_id cascade, name (≤ 100), position int, created_at; index (space_id, position).
- `space_channel_overwrites`: PK(chat_id → chats cascade, target_type, target_id), target_type CHECK in ('role','member'), allow integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deny integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK `(allow & deny) = 0`. `space_category_overwrites`: same shape keyed by category_id → space_categories cascade (templates only; never evaluated).
- `space_bans`: PK(space_id, user_id), banned_by SET NULL, reason (≤ 512), created_at, expires_at NULL.
- `space_invites`: code text PK (INVITE_CODE_ALPHABET/LENGTH, packages/shared/src/constants.ts:144-146), space_id cascade, channel_id → chats SET NULL, created_by SET NULL, max_uses int NULL, uses int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at NULL, created_at; index (space_id).
- `space_audit_log`: id, space_id cascade, actor_id SET NULL, action text (≤ 64), target_type text, target_id uuid NULL, changes jsonb, reason text NULL, created_at; index (space_id, created_at desc).
  Changes:
- `chats` (schema.ts:271-326): `type` (275) += `'space_text' | 'space_voice'`; `space_id → spaces CASCADE`, `category_id → space_categories SET NULL`, `position int`, `topic text` (≤ 1024), `slowmode_seconds int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK 0..21600`, `nsfw bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false`, `user_limit int NULL CHECK 0..MAX_VOICE_CHANNEL_PARTICIPANTS`, `permissions_synced bool NOT NULL DEFAULT true`; index `chats_space_idx (space_id, position) where space_id is not null`. CHECKs: `chats_type_ck` superset; `chats_space_ck: (space_id is not null) = (type in ('space_text','space_voice'))`; `chats_space_cols_ck: type in space types or (category_id is null and position is null and topic is null and user_limit is null)`; `chats_space_invite_ck: type not in space types or invite_code is null` (required: `findInvite` throws 404 for any `chats.invite_code` hit that is not a channel/non-announcement group, apps/server/src/modules/invites/routes.ts:54-56, and never falls through to the later lookups). Existing `chats_direct_key_ck`, `chats_group_settings_ck` (315), `chats_channel_settings_ck` (316-319), `chats_community_ck` (320) are equalities, so space rows are forced to NULL `direct_key`/`group_settings`/`channel_settings`/`community_id` by construction.
- `chat_members`: `notify_level text NULL CHECK in ('all','mentions','none')`, `last_sent_at timestamptz(3)` (slowmode); partial index `chat_members_joined_seq_idx (chat_id, joined_seq) where joined_seq > 0` (does not exist today — 0000_init.sql has only `chat_members_chat_active_idx`; bounds `messageUpdatedPayloads` for space types, see Performance).
- `messages` (schema.ts:386-433): `mention_everyone bool NOT NULL DEFAULT false`, `mention_role_ids uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` next to `mentions` (407-410).
  Invariants (added to ARCHITECTURE "Data model essentials", :128-146): one default role per space; owner is a member; space channel ⇔ `space_id`; a `chat_members` row for a space channel exists iff the member has VIEW_CHANNEL (maintained by `syncChannelAccess`); space channel rows are never `hidden`, never `left_at`, role always `member`.

### 0004_voice.sql (P3c)

- `voice_states`: `user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY → users CASCADE` (one voice channel per user, mirrors `call_participants_one_joined_uq` schema.ts:641-644), `space_id → spaces CASCADE NOT NULL`, `chat_id → chats CASCADE NOT NULL`, `session_id → sessions SET NULL`, `participant_sid text`, `self_mute`, `self_deaf`, `video`, `streaming` bool DEFAULT false, `joined_at`, `connected_at timestamptz(3) NULL` (set by `participant_joined`), `updated_at`; indexes (chat_id), (space_id). Never `calls` rows: `recoverCalls` ends every live call at boot (apps/server/src/modules/calls/service.ts:1201-1226) and `endVerdict` ends rooms with < 2 joined (357-372).

### 0005_spaces_cleanup.sql (P3d, guarded)

`DO $$ BEGIN IF (SELECT count(*) FROM communities) > 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'communities not converted'; END IF; END $$;` then DROP `community_members`, `communities`, `chats.community_id`, `chats.is_announcement`, `chats_community_ck`, `chats_announcement_ck`, `chats_community_announcement_uq`, `chats_community_idx`. `spaces.legacy_community_id` stays for traceability. Plus `space_audit_log` retention job (90 days).

### P4 reservations (no migration now)

`space_emojis` (media FK + GC clause), `message_reactions` PK → (message_id, user_id, emoji) (constraint `message_reactions_message_id_user_id_pk`, apps/server/drizzle/0000_init.sql:153), threads as child chats (`chats.parent_message_id`), `space_members.avatar_media_id`.

## Shared contracts (models/constants/schemas/routes/events/utils per phase)

Every phase starts with packages/shared + docs. `packages/shared` already has vitest (`packages/shared/package.json:15,21`, `--passWithNoTests`, hoisted vitest 3.2.7; no test files yet); new pure modules get real tests there. packages/shared/tsconfig.json has `include: ["src"]` and `types: []`, so test files placed in `src/` are typechecked and must `import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'` explicitly (no globals); no vitest.config is needed (default include pattern).

### P1

- constants.ts: `BIO_MAX_LENGTH=190`, `PRONOUNS_MAX_LENGTH=40`, `PRESENCE_NOTE_MAX_LENGTH=128`, `PRESENCE_IDLE_AFTER_MS=600_000`, `MAX_BANNER_BYTES=10 MiB`, `BANNER_MIME_TYPES=[jpeg,png,webp,gif]`, `BANNER_ASPECT=[5,2]`, `MAX_ANIMATED_AVATAR_BYTES=8 MiB`, `ANIMATED_IMAGE_MIME_TYPES=[gif,webp,png]` (APNG sniffs as png, apps/server/src/services/uploads.ts:27; `AVATAR_MIME_TYPES` at constants.ts:205 stays untouched — apps/web/src/features/settings/profile/avatar.ts encodes with `AVATAR_MIME_TYPES[0]`), `IMAGE_HEADER_MAX_DIMENSION=8192`, `ANIMATED_MAX_FRAMES=400`, `ANIMATED_DECODED_PIXEL_BUDGET=200_000_000`, `IMAGE_PROBE_BYTES=65536`, `USER_RATE_LIMITS.profileUpdate {20/min}`, `presenceActivity {30/min per socket}`.
- models.ts: `Availability`, `PresenceState='online'|'idle'|'dnd'|'offline'`, `PresenceNote {text, emoji, expiresAt}`; `Presence` (131-137) += `state: PresenceState|null`, `note: PresenceNote|null` (null whenever `online` is null); `UserPublic` (74-94) += `avatarAnimatedUrl`, `bannerUrl`, `bannerAnimatedUrl`, `pronouns`, `bio`, `profileColor`, `accentColor` (all `|null`), `presenceState`, `presenceNote`, `createdAt: ISODate|null` (null in the deleted branch — fixes design 1's non-null/deleted contradiction); `UserSelf` (97-107) += the profile fields raw + `availability`, `availabilityUntil`, `presenceNote`; `MediaAttachment` (145-162) += `animated: boolean`, `frameCount: number|null`. Rule: `avatarUrl`/`bannerUrl` are ALWAYS static (poster when animated) so every renderer and push icon (apps/server/src/modules/push/notifications.ts:128,204) stays static.
- schemas.ts: `hexColorSchema` (pattern of createStatusSchema 591-594, lowercased); `updateProfileSchema` (207-215) += `bannerMediaId`, `pronouns`, `bio`, `profileColor`, `accentColor`; `updateAvailabilitySchema {availability, until?}`, `updatePresenceNoteSchema {text|null, emoji|null (emojiSchema 131-147), expiresAt|null}`, socket `presenceActivitySchema {idle}` next to presenceSubscribeSchema (669-671); inferred types at 736-790.
- api.ts (Me block 243-250): `'PUT /api/me/presence'`, `'PUT /api/me/presence-note'`, `'DELETE /api/me/presence-note'` (R UserSelf); `'GET /api/config'` (219-221) R += `publicUrl`, `voice: {url}|null`, `limits {maxUploadBytes, maxAvatarBytes, maxAnimatedAvatarBytes, maxBannerBytes, maxWallpaperBytes}`.
- events.ts: C2S `'presence:activity'` (236-276). `presence:update` (163) carries the new fields.
- NEW `imageInfo.ts` (exported from index.ts): `readImageInfo(bytes: Uint8Array)` → `{mime,width,height,animated,frameCount,loopCount,hasMetadata}|null` (GIF: dims at 6-9, block walk counting `0x2C` descriptors, NETSCAPE loop; WebP: VP8X flags byte 20 `0x02` anim / `0x04` XMP / `0x08` EXIF / `0x20` ICC, ANMF count; PNG/APNG: IHDR, `acTL` before IDAT, `fcTL` count; JPEG: SOF dims, APPn presence; AVIF `avis` → animated, never accepted for profile media) and `stripImageMetadata(bytes)` (GIF: drop `0xFE`/`0x01`/non-NETSCAPE app extensions; WebP: drop EXIF/XMP/ICCP, clear flags, fix RIFF size; PNG: drop eXIf/iTXt/tEXt/zTXt/tIME; JPEG: drop APP1/APP13/COM). Pure Uint8Array, Node and browser. Tests `imageInfo.test.ts` with explicit vitest imports.
- utils.ts: `isDnd(row, now)`, `effectiveAvailability`, `activePresenceNote` next to `isMuted` (49-51).

## Permissions

`packages/shared/src/permissions.ts` (exported from index.ts; both sides MUST use it, same rule as `computeChatPermissions` utils.ts:101-108).

Flags (`1 << bit`; stored in `space_roles.permissions`, `space_*_overwrites.allow/deny` as int4 — int8 parses to Number at apps/server/src/db/index.ts:66-67 anyway, and JS bitwise is 32-bit, so bit 31 is never used): 0 VIEW_CHANNEL, 1 SEND_MESSAGES, 2 EMBED_LINKS (reserved), 3 ATTACH_FILES, 4 ADD_REACTIONS, 5 USE_EXTERNAL_EMOJI (reserved), 6 MENTION_EVERYONE, 7 MANAGE_MESSAGES, 8 READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY (reserved), 9 SEND_POLLS, 10 CREATE_INVITE, 11 CHANGE_NICKNAME, 12 MANAGE_NICKNAMES, 13 KICK_MEMBERS, 14 BAN_MEMBERS, 15 MODERATE_MEMBERS (timeout), 16 MANAGE_CHANNELS, 17 MANAGE_ROLES, 18 MANAGE_SPACE, 19 VIEW_AUDIT_LOG, 20 MANAGE_WEBHOOKS (reserved), 21 MANAGE_EMOJI (reserved), 22 CONNECT, 23 SPEAK, 24 VIDEO, 25 STREAM, 26 MUTE_MEMBERS, 27 DEAFEN_MEMBERS, 28 MOVE_MEMBERS, 29 PRIORITY_SPEAKER (reserved), 30 ADMINISTRATOR. `RESERVED_PERMISSIONS` mask is rejected by `permissionsSchema` and hidden in the editor; `ASSIGNABLE = ALL & ~RESERVED`. `DEFAULT_EVERYONE_PERMISSIONS = VIEW_CHANNEL|SEND_MESSAGES|ATTACH_FILES|ADD_REACTIONS|SEND_POLLS|CREATE_INVITE|CHANGE_NICKNAME|CONNECT|SPEAK|VIDEO|STREAM` (no MENTION_EVERYONE). `ADMIN_ROLE_PERMISSIONS = ADMINISTRATOR` (migration "Admin" role). `TEXT_BITS`/`VOICE_BITS` masks.

Algorithm (pure): `computeBasePermissions({ownerId, viewerId, everyoneRole, roles, memberRoleIds})`: owner → ALL; base = everyone | OR(member roles); `base & ADMINISTRATOR` → ALL. `computeChannelPermissions(base, {channelType, overwrites (channel scope only), everyoneRoleId, memberRoleIds, viewerId, timedOut})`: p = base; ow(@everyone): `p = (p & ~deny) | allow`; role overwrites of my roles: `p = (p & ~OR(deny)) | OR(allow)`; member overwrite last; `!(p & VIEW_CHANNEL) → 0`; text channels clear VOICE_BITS, voice channels clear text-only bits (SEND_MESSAGES|MANAGE_MESSAGES|ATTACH_FILES|SEND_POLLS|MENTION_EVERYONE|ADD_REACTIONS); timed out (and not ADMINISTRATOR/owner) clears SEND_MESSAGES|ADD_REACTIONS|MENTION_EVERYONE|SEND_POLLS|CONNECT|SPEAK|VIDEO|STREAM. Hierarchy: `highestRolePosition(roles, roleIds)` (@everyone = 0, owner = +∞); `canActOn(actor, target)` = actor is owner || (target ≠ owner && actorHighest > targetHighest); `canAssignRole(actor, role)` = owner || role.position < actorHighest; role editors cannot grant bits they lack unless ADMINISTRATOR; @everyone cannot be deleted/repositioned/hoisted; the owner cannot be kicked/banned/timed out. Category overwrites are templates: copied to the channel on create and on `POST …/overwrites/sync` (sets `permissions_synced=true`); editing a channel overwrite sets it false; editing a category overwrite propagates to synced channels only.

Mapping `spaceChannelPermissions(bits, type) → ChatPermissions` (the space branch of `computeChatPermissions`, placed BEFORE the direct/channel/announcement branches at utils.ts:113/126/141 so the group fall-through at :153-169 is never reached): canSend = text && SEND_MESSAGES; canEditInfo = MANAGE_CHANNELS; canAddMembers/canRemoveMembers/canManageAdmins/canLeave = false; canPin = MANAGE_MESSAGES; canCall = false (voice uses `voice:join`); canInvite = CREATE_INVITE; canDeleteForEveryoneAsAdmin = MANAGE_MESSAGES; canViewMembers = true. Bits without a boolean (ATTACH_FILES, ADD_REACTIONS, MENTION_EVERYONE, SEND_POLLS, voice/moderation bits) are checked with `requireSpaceBit(access, PERM.X)` (server) / `hasPerm(chat.spacePermissions, PERM.X)` (client). Space-level actions use `Space.myPermissions` via `requireSpacePermission(dbx, spaceId, me, bit)` (404 non-member per api.ts rule 9, 403 lacking bit, pattern of `requireCommunityRole` apps/server/src/modules/communities/routes.ts:85-98).

Server integration: `computePermissions` (chats.ts:307-325) accepts `spacePermissions`; `getChatAccess` (chats.ts:381-411) calls `loadSpacePermissionInputs(dbx, [{chatId,userId}])` for space rows (3 batched queries: member+roles via `array_agg`, roles of the space, channel overwrites) and applies `timed_out_until`; `ChatAccess` (chats.ts:328-337) gains `spacePermissions`. `buildSummaries` (summaries.ts:108-259) batches the same loader for all space entries (fixed query count kept). Existing guards `requirePermission`/`assertCanSend`/`canEditMessage`/`canDeleteForEveryone` (chats.ts:431-467, utils.ts:185-215) work unchanged; extra gates: ATTACH_FILES on media sends (messages/service.ts:178), ADD_REACTIONS in `react` (403-432), SEND_POLLS for polls, MANAGE_MESSAGES already via `canDeleteForEveryoneAsAdmin` (messages/service.ts:362).

Propagation (normative, added to fan-out rules): role/overwrite edits emit `space:updated {roles}` / `chat:updated {overwrites, permissionsSynced}` to the room and run `syncChannelAccess` (VIEW_CHANNEL deltas only). Clients recompute `spacePermissions` then `permissions` in `stores/spaces.recompute` (after `applyChatUpdate`, apps/web/src/stores/chats.ts:308-321, and on `space:updated`/`space:member-updated` for my roleIds/timeout). Server test: removing SEND_MESSAGES from @everyone emits no `chat:upsert` and a subsequent `GET /spaces/:id/channels` shows the new bits; web test: the same edit flips `permissions.canSend` client-side.

Examples: (1) plain member, no overwrites → DEFAULT_EVERYONE → canSend, no canPin. (2) `#announcements` overwrite @everyone deny SEND_MESSAGES, Admin role ADMINISTRATOR → members read-only, admins post. (3) role Muted deny SEND on `#general` + member overwrite allow SEND for one user → that user sends (member wins). (4) `#staff` @everyone deny VIEW + role Staff allow VIEW → only Staff get rows; others get `chat:removed` and 404. (5) timed-out moderator with MANAGE_MESSAGES: canPin true, canSend false.

## Voice (LiveKit)

Topology: LiveKit v1.13.7 (`/opt/livekit/livekit-server`, `livekit.service`), API on 127.0.0.1:7880 via `bind_addresses: ['127.0.0.1']` (verified in `pkg/service/server.go`: `BindAddresses` only feeds the `net.Listen("tcp", host:conf.Port)` loop for the API, Prometheus and debug listeners; the RTC side in `mediatransportutil pkg/rtcconfig/webrtc_config.go` has no bind IP — still verified on staging with `ss -lunp | grep 7882` before rollout), nginx `location /livekit/` on all three domains (see Infrastructure), `rtc.udp_port: 7882-7892` (mux range; `rtc.port_range_start`/`rtc.port_range_end` MUST be absent — when set they win over `udp_port`) + `rtc.tcp_port: 7881`, `rtc.use_external_ip: true`, `rtc.turn_servers: [{host, port: 3478, protocol: udp, secret: ${TURN_SECRET}, ttl: 3600}]`, `webhook.urls: ['http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/voice/webhook']`, `room: {auto_create: true, empty_timeout: 300}`, `keys: {${LIVEKIT_API_KEY}: ${LIVEKIT_API_SECRET}}`. The rendered `livekit.yaml` is validated by a deploy pre-check that greps for `port_range_` and fails if present.

Server (`apps/server/src/modules/voice/{provider.ts,livekit.ts,fake.ts,service.ts,state.ts,socket.ts,routes.ts,webhook.ts}`, `jobs/voice.ts`): `VoiceProvider` interface (`mintToken`, `createRoom`, `listRooms`, `listParticipants`, `removeParticipant`, `updateParticipant`, `mutePublishedTrack`, `moveParticipant`, `deleteRoom`, `verifyWebhook`) implemented with `livekit-server-sdk` 2.19.1 (not installed today; `new AccessToken(apiKey, secret, {identity: userId, name: displayName, ttl: VOICE_TOKEN_TTL_SEC, metadata: JSON.stringify({sessionId})})`, `addGrant({roomJoin: true, room: chatId, canPublish, canPublishSources, canSubscribe, canPublishData: true, hidden: false})`, `await toJwt()`; `RoomServiceClient(hostUrl, key, secret)`; `WebhookReceiver(key, secret).receive(body: string, authHeader)` — it takes the raw body as a STRING and throws "sha256 checksum of body does not match", so the `express.raw` Buffer is passed as `body.toString('utf8')` untouched) and a `FakeProvider` injected via `initConfig({voice: {provider: 'fake'}})` (apps/server/test/helpers.ts:48) — `config.ts` gets a `voice` block (interface 36-76, loadConfig 78-114, explicit nested merge next to `ice`/`vapid` at 115-120, which spread only those two blocks today).

Join (`voice:join`, socket ack; per-user FIFO via the `withCallQueue` pattern apps/server/src/modules/calls/state.ts:46-58 keyed by userId): `assertUserLimit(voiceJoin)` → `transact`: `requireActiveMember(tx, me, chatId, {lock: true})` on the `space_voice` chat (row exists only with VIEW_CHANNEL) → `requireSpaceBit(CONNECT)` (timed-out stripped) → **busy lock + combined busy check** (below) → existing `voice_states` row: same chat + same session → idempotent re-ack; other chat → move (update row, `voice:state null` for the old chat); other session → 409 busy unless `takeover` (then `voice:disconnect {takeover}` → old session + `removeParticipant` post-commit) → `user_limit` (count rows `where chat_id and connected_at is not null`) unless MOVE_MEMBERS/ADMINISTRATOR → 409 `limit_reached` → upsert row (`connected_at null`) → `fx.toSpace('voice:state', …)` → post-commit `createRoom` (idempotent) + mint (grants: `canPublish = hasAny(SPEAK|VIDEO|STREAM) && !server_mute`, `canPublishSources: [microphone iff SPEAK, camera iff VIDEO, screen_share(+audio) iff STREAM]`, `canSubscribe = !server_deaf`) → bind the socket (`bindVoiceSocket`, state.ts:65-142 pattern) → ack `{url: config.voice.url, token, ttlSec, state, participants}`.

Mesh ↔ voice mutual exclusion (corrected lock facts): today call-vs-call exclusion is NOT lock-based — it is the partial unique index `call_participants_one_joined_uq` on `(user_id) where status = 'joined'` (schema.ts:641-644, 0000_init.sql:296), whose violation `mapDbErrors` turns into 409 "You are already in another call" (calls/service.ts:576-577), with `joinedCallId` (:606-613, module-private) as the friendly pre-check at :709 and :821. That index cannot see `voice_states`. The locks the two paths hold: `startCall` holds only the chat row (`getChatAccess(..., {lock: true})` at :690 → `lockChat`); `joinCall` runs through `runCallOp` (:583-590) → in-process per-call queue → `applyInTx` (:540-550) → `lockCallCtx` (:329-345), which locks the chat row (:336) THEN the call row `FOR UPDATE` (:337). Design: a new `apps/server/src/services/busy.ts` exports `lockUserBusy(tx, userId)` = `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('enbox:busy:'||userId, 0))` (precedent `lockPinnedChats`, apps/server/src/modules/chats/service.ts:161-165) and `assertNotBusy(tx, userId, opts)` (after the lock: a `joined` `call_participants` row → 409 "You are already in another call"; a `voice_states` row → 409 "Leave the voice channel first", both with `except` options for re-joins/moves). It is called in exactly three places, ALWAYS after every row lock of the path and before any write: `startCall` after :690 (replacing the :709 check), `joinCall` at the top of its op — i.e. after `lockCallCtx` — replacing :821, and `voice:join` after `requireActiveMember(lock)`. The invariant "row locks → busy lock → writes" keeps the three paths free of lock cycles (a later `call_participants` insert can only wait on the unique index of a transaction that already holds the same busy lock, which cannot happen); the argument in the `lockPinnedChats` comment (chats/service.ts:156-160, "only this code path takes it") does NOT transfer once three paths take a lock, so the helper's doc comment states the order and a real-PG test (`ENBOX_TEST_PG_URL`) races `startCall` against `voice:join` for the same user in both orders. `mapDbErrors` (:576-577) stays as the last line of defence for calls. The alternative — a shared "one busy row per user" table or trigger spanning `call_participants` and `voice_states` — was rejected because it would rewrite the calls state machine's participant transitions.

Leave: `voice:leave` (bound socket; pending-leave middleware pattern calls/socket.ts:66-77) or disconnect → grace `VOICE_RECONNECT_GRACE_MS` → row deleted unless the reconciler still sees the participant → `voice:state null` → `removeParticipant` (best effort). `voice:state` persists self flags (`SERVER_RATE_LIMITS.voiceState`) and broadcasts. `voice:speaking` (bound socket only, transitions only, never while muted, `voiceSpeaking` limit) → `voice:speaking` to the space room. `POST /api/voice/token` re-mints for an existing row (reconnect after expiry; `Cache-Control: no-store`).

Moderation (`PATCH /spaces/:id/members/:u`): serverMute/serverDeaf (MUTE_MEMBERS/DEAFEN_MEMBERS + hierarchy) → `space_members` flags → `voice:state` + `space:member-updated` → post-commit `updateParticipant(room, identity, undefined, {canPublish/canSubscribe/canPublishSources})` + `mutePublishedTrack` for each audio track from `listParticipants`; move (MOVE_MEMBERS, target CONNECT check for the moved user; no busy lock — the user stays in voice and the `voice_states` row lock serialises against a concurrent self-join) → row update + `voice:state` for both chats + `moveParticipant` (server SDK) + `voice:disconnect {moved, moveTo}` → user (client re-tokens if the SFU move fails); disconnect (MOVE_MEMBERS) → delete row + `voice:disconnect {kicked}` + `removeParticipant`. Forced leaves: `domainEvents 'member.left'` with the new `'revoked'` reason (apps/server/src/services/events.ts:35), kick/ban/leave space, `registerChatDeletionHook('voice')` (channel/space deletion → rows deleted, `deleteRoom`), `registerAccountDeletionHook('voice')` (hooks.ts:24-33, run in registration order inside the deletion tx), session revocation (`session_id` SET NULL → reconciler leaves).

Webhook: `app.post('/api/voice/webhook', express.raw({type: 'application/webhook+json', limit: '256kb'}), handler)` registered on `app` BEFORE `app.use('/api', api)` (apps/server/src/app.ts:86). Why: the `/api` router applies `express.json` (:80, whose default `type` is `application/json`, so it would not parse `application/webhook+json` anyway) and `apiLimiter` (:81, express-rate-limit 1200/min keyed by `req.ip` — LiveKit's retries from 127.0.0.1 must never count against it); a route registered before :86 that ends the response reaches neither, and the SPA catch-all (:94) already excludes `/api/`. `receive(rawBody.toString('utf8'), req.headers.authorization)`, 401 without body echo; dedupe on `event.id` (LRU 1000); ignore events older than the row's `updated_at`; `participant_joined` → `connected_at`, `participant_sid` (identity = userId; `metadata.sessionId` must match the row, else `removeParticipant`); `participant_left` → delete when `participant_sid` matches and no live binding within grace; `room_finished` → delete rows of that chat; `track_published/unpublished` (camera/screen_share) → video/streaming flags. LiveKit retries a webhook request multiple times and sequences events but gives "no guarantees around delivery", so `jobs/voice.ts` (runOnStart + every 30 s) is the source of truth: `listRooms`/`listParticipants` vs `voice_states` — rows with no participant and `joined_at < now − VOICE_CONNECT_GRACE_MS` deleted + `voice:state null`; participants without rows removed; rooms of deleted chats deleted; AFK move (`afk_channel_id`, `afk_timeout_sec`, client idle flag from P1 `presence:activity`). Enbox restarts never blanket-end voice; LiveKit restarts surface as `voice:disconnect {reconcile}`.

Client: `livekit-client` 2.22.3 behind `features/voice/engine/LiveKitEngine.ts` (lazy `import('livekit-client')`, `vendor-livekit` manualChunk in apps/web/vite.config.ts:57-69): `connect(new URL(config.voice.url, location.origin) → wss, token)`, `setMicrophoneEnabled/setCameraEnabled/setScreenShareEnabled`, deafen = `remoteParticipants.forEach(p => p.setVolume(0))` + local flag (server deafen is enforced by `canSubscribe: false`), output device via `Room.switchActiveDevice('audiooutput')`, `RoomEvent.ActiveSpeakersChanged` → local speaking set + own transition relay; remote tracks wrapped in `MediaStream`s registered in `features/calls/engine/streams.ts` so `ParticipantTile`/`VideoView`/`useTrackLive` are reused. `stores/voice.ts` (occupancy per chat, `mine`, speaking sets; `registerSessionReset`), `realtime/voice.ts` (`voice:*` handlers; `resyncVoice` = `GET /spaces/:id/voice-states` for open spaces + idempotent `voice:join` if connected), `features/voice/controller.ts` (join/leave/takeover prompt/re-token/auto-rejoin from `sessionStorage 'enbox.voice.current'`, controller.ts:1066-1246 pattern); `busyWithAnotherCall` (features/calls/controller.ts:636-651) also checks the voice store; accepting a mesh call offers "Leave voice & accept". UI: `VoiceChannelRow` occupants (avatars, speaking ring, mute/deaf/video badges, `n/limit`), `VoiceDock` (bottom of the channel sidebar; phone floating bar) mounted next to `CallOverlay` (apps/web/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx:33-35; z below CallMiniWindow z-[45]), `VoiceStage` (grid via `gridColumns`, screen share featured; desktop-only share like CallControls.tsx:34), audio-blocked banner reused from CallScreen. sw.js `isBypassed` (apps/web/public/sw.js:61-72) += `/livekit/`; Vite proxy (vite.config.ts:26-30) += `'/livekit': {target: env.LIVEKIT_DEV_URL || 'http://localhost:7880', ws: true, rewrite: strip prefix}`.

Failure modes: LiveKit down → `voice:join` acks 503 `voice_unavailable` (provider health probe cached 5 s) and voice rows show "Voice unavailable"; webhook lost → reconcile ≤ 30 s; token expired on reconnect → `POST /api/voice/token`; UDP blocked → ICE-TCP 7881 or TURN relay; second device → 409 busy unless takeover; single-instance in-memory bindings (same assumption as calls/state.ts:1-11, documented).

## Media pipeline

Client detection: `lib/media.ts probeImageFile(file)` sniffs the first `IMAGE_PROBE_BYTES` with shared `readImageInfo` (full read only for animated candidates within caps; `ImageDecoder` frame pick when available, Safari falls back to the first frame); replaces `file.type === 'image/gif'` at apps/web/src/features/conversation/lib/mediaProcessing.ts:136 and features/status/media.ts:54 with `info.animated`, so animated WebP/APNG survive and a renamed JPEG is re-encoded. Animated files skip the canvas re-encode, are metadata-stripped client-side (best effort) and get a poster from `decodeImage` → `makeThumbnail` (mediaProcessing.ts:81-97; WebP variant for alpha, 960 px for banners under MAX_THUMBNAIL_BYTES) sent as the `thumbnail` part: `api.upload` (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:358-423) gains `UploadOptions.thumbnail?: Blob` (327-331) appended after :420 (the server already accepts it, apps/server/src/modules/media/routes.ts:63-66, 99-107). Static photos keep the canvas path; `avatar.ts:129-151` bypassed only for animated input.

Server (`POST /api/media`, routes.ts:82-141): after sniff + allowlist (92-97) and for `kind === 'image'`: `probeImageFile` (services/imageProbe.ts, reusing `readImageInfo` on the head + a chunk/block walk with `FileHandle.read`) rejects 400 (never 500) when width/height > IMAGE_HEADER_MAX_DIMENSION, frames > ANIMATED_MAX_FRAMES, w×h×frames > ANIMATED_DECODED_PIXEL_BUDGET, frame rects outside the canvas or parse failure; `stripImageFileMetadata` rewrites the temp file (new `size`) before `moveIntoStore` (114); the insert (116-131) uses parsed `width/height` (overriding the client meta at 124-125), `animated`, `frame_count`, `metadata_stripped`; the thumbnail part is stripped too. APNG keeps `image/png` (uploads.ts:27) with `animated=true`. Requirers (services/media.ts next to 90-100): `requireAvatarMedia` → static (AVATAR_MIME_TYPES, MAX_AVATAR_BYTES) or animated (`row.animated`, ANIMATED_IMAGE_MIME_TYPES, MAX_ANIMATED_AVATAR_BYTES, `thumbnailKey` required → 400 "Animated images need a static poster"); `requireBannerMedia`; `requireWallpaperMedia` (image ≤ MAX_WALLPAPER_BYTES or video ≤ MAX_WALLPAPER_VIDEO_BYTES with `durationMs ≤ MAX_WALLPAPER_VIDEO_MS`, poster required for animated/video); space icon/banner reuse them; all called inside the referencing tx (`FOR KEY SHARE`, media.ts:66-87). GC list: `users.banner_media_id`, `chat_members.wallpaper_media_id`, `spaces.icon_media_id`, `spaces.banner_media_id` (P4: `space_emojis.media_id`), each covered by apps/server/test/media.test.ts.

Wire: `MediaAttachment.animated/frameCount`; `avatarUrl`/`bannerUrl` always static; `avatarAnimatedUrl`/`bannerAnimatedUrl`/`iconAnimatedUrl` additive; `getUserRows` (services/users.ts:80-94) selects `thumbnailKey`/`animated` and a second `alias(media,'banner')` join (`UserWithAvatar` :41). Rendering: `Avatar` (apps/web/src/components/ui/Avatar.tsx:41-58, img 113-122) gains append-only `animatedSrc?`, `animate?: 'hover'|'always'|'never'` (default 'hover': swap `src` on hover/focus-within; 'always' only in the profile card/lightbox), `presence?: PresenceState|null` (online dot / idle moon / dnd minus; `online` kept); never animates under `useReducedMotion()` (new hook in apps/web/src/hooks/useMediaQuery.ts: media query OR `prefs.reduceMotion === 'on'`), `prefs.autoplayAnimatedMedia === 'never'`, or when `!useAppVisible()` (apps/web/src/hooks/useAppVisible.ts:15-21). Chat GIF bubbles (MediaBody) show the poster + GIF badge under 'hover'/'never'; `ChatBackground` shows the poster under reduced motion / hidden. /uploads inline list (app.ts:16-34) already covers gif/webp/png/mp4/webm; the 365-day immutable cache (app.ts:64-66) makes src swaps free.

## Presence & availability

Persisted on `users` (P1 columns). Wire: `Presence.state` (never `'invisible'`) + `Presence.note`, mirrored into `UserPublic` for seeding (apps/web/src/stores/users.ts:113-128; `samePresence` 105-107 compares state/note too); `UserSelf` carries the raw choice.

`buildPresence` (apps/server/src/services/users.ts:344-357) is the single place: outer gate `canSeePresence` (328-341) unchanged; `effectiveOnline = isOnline(id) && availability !== 'invisible'`; `online = canSeeOnline ? effectiveOnline : null`; `state = !canSeeOnline ? null : !effectiveOnline ? 'offline' : isDnd ? 'dnd' : (availability === 'idle' || autoIdle(id)) ? 'idle' : 'online'`; `lastSeenAt = canSeeLastSeen && !effectiveOnline ? row.lastSeenAt : null`; `note` only while `state ∈ {online,idle,dnd}` and unexpired.

Invisible invariants: (1) an invisible connected user serialises byte-identical to a really offline one, so the `lastSent` dedupe (apps/server/src/modules/users/presence.ts:104-105) emits nothing on their connect/disconnect/idle; (2) `PUT /me/presence` switching to invisible writes `last_seen_at = now()` in the same tx (`lockMe` routes.ts:79-83) and registers `presenceEffect` (86-90) + `meUpdatedEffect` (63-73); (3) the disconnect path, precisely: the `last_seen_at` write in io.ts:100-112 is already gated — it runs only when the socket was `counted` (:102) and `markDisconnected` says this process's last socket for the user closed (:104, realtime/presence.ts:42-50) — but it has no row-state predicate (`where id = $userId`, :108), it is fire-and-forget (not awaited, `.catch` only, :106-109), and the `presenceEvents.emit('offline', userId, lastSeenAt)` at :110 (signature realtime/presence.ts:18-21) hands the in-memory timestamp to `reevaluatePresence` (users/socket.ts:16-19), whose `evaluate` applies it as an override whenever the row's value is null or older (presence.ts:87-90). Two changes are therefore both required: the UPDATE gains `and availability <> 'invisible'` inside the existing gate, AND `evaluate` ignores `override.lastSeenAt` when `row.availability === 'invisible'` — the conditional write alone is not enough because the override is applied from memory regardless of (and possibly before) the write; (4) `onlineVisibility`/`lastSeenVisibility`/blocks keep precedence (invisible only hides more); (5) self view only via `UserSelf`. Documented residual side channels: delivered ticks (watermarks.ts:593-600, 614-656) and the `call:ringing` ack, as for hidden online today.

Idle: `lib/activity.ts` (pointer/keydown/wheel/touch + `visibilitychange`, PRESENCE_IDLE_AFTER_MS) sends `presence:activity {idle}` on transitions and on every `ready` (from `resyncUsers`, apps/web/src/realtime/users.ts:53-60); server keeps `socketIdle` per socket in realtime/presence.ts (no idle state exists there today — only `counts`, subscriptions and the two events `online`/`offline`; dropped in `dropPresenceSocket` 103-106, ignored until counted), `autoIdle(userId)` = every counted socket idle, `presenceEvents 'activity'` → `reevaluatePresence` (users/socket.ts:15-19 pattern). DND: shared `isDnd()` gates push in `onMessageCreated` (notifications.ts:96-103), `onCallRinging` (183-186) and `onRingStopped` (same predicate); DND callees join `silentUserIds` (calls/service.ts:180-196) → silent ring (SilencedCallCard, no ringtone, no `call:ringing`); client `notifyIncoming` (apps/web/src/realtime/messages.ts:127-159) returns after the settings gate (133); badges unaffected. Expiry: `jobs/presenceExpiry.ts` (registerJob, 60 s, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` batches like jobs/statusExpiry.ts:10-14; added to jobs/register.ts:4-8) clears `availability_until`/notes, then `reevaluatePresence` + `me:updated`; clients hide notes locally at `expiresAt`. Space member lists subscribe presence for rendered rows only (≤ MAX_PRESENCE_SUBSCRIPTIONS 1000/socket, 30/min); `Space.onlineCount` = members with `isOnline && availability !== 'invisible' && onlineVisibility = 'everyone'` (documented). `PUBLIC_URL` (config.ts:85; read by no code today — only test/helpers.ts:48 sets it) is exposed by `GET /api/config` (apps/server/src/modules/system/routes.ts:12-19, which returns only `vapidPublicKey/maxUploadBytes/version` today) and consumed by `inviteUrl()` (apps/web/src/features/groups/shared/share.ts:5-8) through a new `lib/serverConfig.ts` (moved from lib/push.ts:21-34).

Profile fan-out to spaces (P3a): `userChangedTargets` (fanout.ts:45-51 = `activeDirectAndGroupChatIds` (:28-42, types at :37, announcement rule :38, hidden rows included) + `usersWhoSaved`) gains the rooms of my spaces; that covers `PATCH /me` (routes.ts:172-173) and `PATCH /me/settings` (which registers `userChangedEffect` only for `profilePhotoVisibility`/`aboutVisibility` changes, routes.ts:235-236). Account deletion does NOT go through `userChangedTargets`: it hand-builds `{chatIds: directChatIds + non-announcement groupIds, userIds: savedBy}` at account.ts:148-149, so the spaces deletion hook also collects my space ids before the rows are deleted and account.ts:149 adds `rooms.space` targets — otherwise co-members would keep a stale name until their next refetch.

## Communities -> Spaces migration

`services/spacesMigration.ts` `migrateCommunitiesToSpaces()` awaited in apps/server/src/index.ts after `initDb` (13) and before `createApp` (14) when `SPACES_MIGRATE` ∈ {on, dry} (default `on`; tests use `off` and call the function directly; `dry` logs the plan without writing). One `transact` per community (sorted by created_at) under `lockCommunityScope(groups: true)` (services/communities.ts:308-339); idempotent via `spaces.legacy_community_id` UNIQUE (already converted → skip); a failure throws so `main()` rejects (index.ts:35-38 → `process.exit(1)`), the process never listens, the host deploy script's `GET /api/health` wait (system/routes.ts:8-10) times out and it rolls back the release; the next boot resumes with the remainder.

Per community C: (1) `spaces` {name, description, icon_media_id = C.avatar_media_id, owner = community owner (fallback oldest admin, then oldest member), created_by, created_at kept, system_channel_id = #announcements, default_notify_level 'mentions', legacy_community_id}. (2) Roles: @everyone {is_default, position 0, DEFAULT_EVERYONE_PERMISSIONS}, "Admin" {position 1, ADMINISTRATOR, hoist, colour brand} assigned to community owner/admins. (3) `space_members` for every `community_members` row (joined_at kept). (4) Categories "Text channels" (0), "Voice channels" (1). (5) Announcement chat A: `UPDATE chats SET type='space_text', space_id, category_id, position 0, name='announcements', community_id=NULL, is_announcement=false, group_settings=NULL, invite_code=NULL, disappearing_seconds=NULL`; overwrite @everyone deny SEND_MESSAGES; A's `chat_members`: `left_at` rows deleted, active rows keep joined_seq/marks, role → 'member', hidden → false. (6) Each linked group G (creation order, position i+1): same in-place conversion (kebab-cased name, topic = description); when `group_settings.onlyAdminsCanSend` → overwrite @everyone deny SEND_MESSAGES; group owner/admins get a member overwrite allow SEND_MESSAGES|MANAGE_MESSAGES|MANAGE_CHANNELS; `chat_members` per D8: active rows keep joined_seq/marks (role → 'member'); rows with `left_reason = 'left'` are deleted and, being community members, re-created with `joined_seq = G.last_seq`, marks = last_seq (future only); rows with `left_reason = 'removed'` (schema.ts:349) are deleted and replaced by a member overwrite `deny VIEW_CHANNEL` (docs 608 exception preserved; a moderator can lift it); community members with no row at all get the future-only row; group members who were not community members (invariant violation, docs 596-605) become space members; live calls on converted chats end via `endChatCallsTx` (registered at calls/socket.ts:56). (7) Voice channel "General" (`space_voice`, category Voice, position 0) with rows for every member (joined_seq 0). (8) Invites: C.invite_code and every G.invite_code → `space_invites` rows (landing A / that channel, no expiry, no max uses) and the chats' `invite_code` set NULL (`chats_space_invite_ck`; `findInvite` 404s any `chats.invite_code` hit whose row is not a channel/non-announcement group, invites/routes.ts:54-56, and would never reach the later lookups) so every shared `/join/<code>` keeps working through the new `findInvite` branch (invites/routes.ts:46-66: chats → communities → space_invites → vanity); `generateUniqueInviteCode` (services/invites.ts:11-28, checks chats :14-19 then communities :20-25) checks the new tables. (9) Audit row `space.migrated`. (10) Delete `community_members` then the `communities` row (chats.community_id already NULL). Stored `community_*` system messages stay renderable. No events are emitted (no sockets exist before listen); clients load everything fresh.

Rollout: maintenance window; `pg_dump` immediately before; the vendored `deploy/deploy.sh` (P3a S4) raises its health-check wait to 10 min for this release; forward-fix-only after the first community commits (the previous release cannot run on converted rows: `chatKindOfRow` chats.ts:157-159 and `systemMessageAllowed` system.ts:39-48 fall through, `toChatSummaries` would list them); old tabs are told to reload: the web build gets `__ENBOX_VERSION__` (Vite `define` from `APP_VERSION`) and compares it with `GET /api/config.version` on every `realtime:ready` → persistent "Enbox was updated — Reload" banner in ConnectionBanner. The communities module (routes/service/hooks, account.ts:49-62 locks) stays for one release with empty tables; UI, stores and realtime for communities are removed in P3b; 0005 drops tables/columns in P3d behind the zero-row guard, after which `chatKindOf 'announcement'`, fanout.ts:38, summaries `isAnnouncement/communityId`, users/routes.ts:314, membership `succession` flag and the community fixtures/tests go. Tests: `test/spaces/migration.test.ts` (createCommunity fixture + linked groups + messages/pins/reactions + a live call + non-member community member + former member who left + former member removed by an admin → run twice → idempotent, history windows preserved (non-member sees nothing before conversion), removed member has no row and a deny-VIEW overwrite, announcements read-only, Admin role, invites converted, call ended, `GET /api/chats` excludes, `GET /spaces/:id/channels` includes), plus a real-PG run of the conversion in CI (see Infrastructure).

## Infrastructure & deployment

- Repo artefacts (new `deploy/` directory, reviewed with the code; today the repo tracks only `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` for deployment, and README "Deployment" 125-135 describes docker-compose only): `deploy/deploy.sh` (vendored `/opt/enbox/deploy.sh`, introduced in P3a S4: build, `APP_VERSION` for build and runtime, migrate-on-boot, `pg_dump` before each release, health-check wait on `GET /api/health` (system/routes.ts:8-10) configurable per release, rollback; P3c adds the LiveKit pre-check `curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:7880/`, rendering `livekit.yaml` from `/etc/enbox/enbox.env`, the `port_range_*` grep guard and `systemctl restart livekit` on config change), `deploy/livekit/livekit.yaml.tmpl`, `deploy/systemd/livekit.service` (User=livekit, Restart=always, LimitNOFILE=65536, After=network-online.target, EnvironmentFile=/etc/enbox/enbox.env), `deploy/nginx/enbox-app.conf.snippet` (`location /livekit/ { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:7880/; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade; proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade"; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_read_timeout 3600s; proxy_send_timeout 3600s; proxy_buffering off; }` — prefix stripped, `livekit-client` appends `/rtc` and `/rtc/validate`), `deploy/nft/enbox-livekit.nft` (allow inbound TCP 7881 + UDP 7882-7892; exception in the existing coturn guard so relays may reach the host's own public IP on those ports).
- Env (`/etc/enbox/enbox.env`, .env.example, README table): `PUBLIC_URL=https://enbox.dev` (canonical for invite links; open question), `SPACES_MIGRATE`, `LIVEKIT_URL=/livekit` (clients resolve it against `location.origin`; absolute wss for Capacitor later), `LIVEKIT_HOST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7880`, `LIVEKIT_API_KEY`, `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET` (`openssl rand -hex 32`), `VOICE_TOKEN_TTL_SEC=900`, `APP_VERSION`.
- Router/NAT: forward TCP 7881 and UDP 7882-7892 to the host (coturn 3478 + relays 50000-50999 and Asterisk 10000-20000 untouched; no overlap). TURN relay path: coturn → host public IP:7882-7892 needs the nft exception AND router hairpin NAT; verified on staging with a TURN-forced client before enabling voice; fallback if hairpin is unavailable: LiveKit embedded TURN (`turn: {enabled, tls_port 5349, domain}` with certs) — decided by the staging test (open question).
- CSP: same-origin `/livekit` keeps `connect-src 'self'` (vite.config.ts:145, build-only plugin `apply: 'build'` at :121) but the plugin's own comment (112-116) notes older Safari does not match wss under `'self'`: add a build var `VITE_WS_ORIGINS=wss://enbox.dev,wss://enbox.cloud,wss://enbox.enfinito.cloud` appended to `connect-src` (vite-env.d.ts, lib/env.ts documented), plus a `worker-src blob:` only if LiveKit E2EE workers are ever enabled (not now).
- Dev: `livekit-server --dev` (`devkey`/`secret`) + Vite `/livekit` ws proxy; `LIVEKIT_DEV_URL` optional.
- CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:9-41): (a) add a `postgres:18` service job running `ENBOX_TEST_PG_URL` so apps/server/test/pg/concurrency.test.ts (skipped today) plus the conversion, `lockSpaceScope`, the busy-lock race and account-deletion lock-order cases run on real Postgres; (b) a second Playwright project in the repo-root `playwright.config.ts` (apps/web has no Playwright config; today its web server at :60-66 runs `npm run dev -w @enbox/web`, so the build-only CSP plugin never executes in e2e even though ci.yml:34-35 builds before `npm run e2e`) that starts the API server with `WEB_DIST_DIR=apps/web/dist` (config.ts:94 defaults to `path.join(process.cwd(), '../web/dist')`, i.e. cwd-relative — it resolves correctly only when started via `-w @enbox/server`; Dockerfile:18 sets it explicitly) and points the browser at the API port (app.ts:88-97 serves the SPA with a fallback), asserting the CSP `<meta>` exists and no `securitypolicyviolation`/"Refused to" console events while logging in, uploading an animated avatar, setting a wallpaper and joining voice with the fake provider; (c) optional `livekit-server --dev` job for the gated voice spec.
- Runtime: `GET /api/config` gains `voice`, `publicUrl`, `limits`, `version` (already there); jobs `presence-expiry` (60 s), `voice-reconcile` (30 s + boot), `audit-log-retention` (daily); single-instance assumptions unchanged and documented.

## Performance budget

- Rows: `chat_members` per space ≤ 2 000 × 100 = 200k worst (≈ 30 MB incl. indexes); realistic 300 × 20 = 6k. `space_member_roles` ≤ members × roles. `voice_states` ≤ online users.
- Connect: `visibleChatIds` (io.ts:18-30, index `chat_members_user_active_idx`) + room joins (in-memory) + `visibleSpaceIds` via `registerRoomSource` (inside the try block :114-128 with its own double-read, before `counted = true` :136 so `onBeforeReady` hooks such as `markDeliveredOnConnect` see the rooms); `markDeliveredOnConnect` (watermarks.ts:614-656) switches `c.type <> 'channel'` (:620 `FOR SHARE` lock query, :633 the update join) to `c.type in ('direct','group')` so no `FOR SHARE` locks or lateral scans on space rows; the other `'channel'` receipt sites (watermarks.ts:120, :307, :703) switch to `!hasReceipts`; `GET /api/chats` excludes space types; `GET /api/spaces` ≤ 100 spaces with roles inline and unread aggregates in a fixed number of queries; channels fetched per opened space (≤ 100 summaries).
- Send in `space_text`: chat lock + seq + insert + targeted mention query + push candidates post-commit (mentions ∪ role members ∪ everyone/here targets ∪ 'all'-level members, capped at PUSH_SPACE_ALL_CAP) — no delivered marks, no watermark diff, no unhide, no per-member loop; `message:new` to the room. `messageUpdatedPayloads` (messages.ts:895-928): today its except query (:907-916) joins `c.type <> 'channel'` (:911) to EVERY active member row (:912) and filters on `joined_seq >= seq or cleared_seq >= seq or exists(message_hidden)` (:914-915) — a full member scan per updated message on the `chat_members_chat_active_idx` index; for space types it gets a separate branch using only `cm.joined_seq >= m.seq` over the new partial index `chat_members_joined_seq_idx` (clear/delete-for-me are forbidden in space channels, blocked-peer hideFrom is direct-only), so a reaction in a 2 000-member channel costs an index range scan, not a member scan. Typing: `canRelayTyping` (chats/socket.ts:28-41) runs `getChatAccess` on every event (:29) after `allowTyping` (:64-65), and for direct chats also `blockedEitherWay` (:37-38); no per-socket access cache exists today (the only precedent is the sessions cache, services/sessions.ts:16 `CACHE_TTL_MS = 30_000`). New: a per-socket `Map<chatId, {ok, at}>` consulted ONLY for space types (never direct/group, whose block check stays fresh), TTL 30 s, cleared on the socket's `chat:removed`/room leave; so the `typingAnyChat` cap (userLimit.ts:27, 20/s per socket) bounds space typing to ≤ 1 access load per (socket, channel) per 30 s, and a stale positive after a revoke is limited to 30 s of typing indicators (documented).
- Role/overwrite edits: `syncChannelAccess` groups members by role-set signature (S distinct sets ≪ N), evaluates S × channels bit ops, writes VIEW deltas only (`INSERT … ON CONFLICT` / `DELETE … WHERE (chat_id,user_id) IN`), emits per-pair JOIN/`chat:removed` up to SPACE_SYNC_UPSERT_LIMIT else one `space:channels-changed`; non-VIEW bits cost one `space:updated`/`chat:updated` and client recompute. Budget: a space-wide role edit on 2 000 × 100 completes in one tx < 5 s (real-PG case in CI).
- Profiles: `user:changed` reaches space rooms (`userChangedTargets` fanout.ts:45-51 gains `rooms.space`; account.ts:149 likewise); it fires only when `PATCH /me` changes a field (routes.ts:167-174) or a visibility setting changes (routes.ts:235-236); receivers refetch only users they already cache (stores/users.ts:164-169) with 0-3 s jitter; `profileUpdate` 20/min; presence notes never use this path (D7).
- Presence: rendered-rows-only subscriptions (≤ 1 000/socket, 30/min); `onlineCount` computed server-side once per Space payload.
- Voice: token mint = one HMAC; `voice:state` ≤ a few/s per space; `voice:speaking` ≤ 2/s per speaker (20/10 s cap), coalesced per animation frame client-side; reconcile = one `listRooms` + one `listParticipants` per room every 30 s; audio-first rooms of ≤ 50 on 16 cores; simulcast/dynacast for video.
- Media: header parse reads ≤ 64 KiB + chunk walks (no decode); metadata strip is a linear copy ≤ 15 MiB, outside transactions.
- Web: `vendor-livekit` chunk lazy; panes via `lazyNamed`; CSS-variable theming (no row re-render); transform/opacity animations only; virtualised member list. Guards: `countQueries` on `spacesForPairs`, `GET /spaces/:id/channels`, push candidates and `syncChannelAccess`.

## Security checklist

- Privacy gates: every new UserPublic field passes `buildUserPublic` (users.ts:360-406): banner/avatarAnimatedUrl follow `profilePhotoVisibility`, bio/pronouns/colours follow `aboutVisibility`, everything null on block (383) or deletion (365-380); presence state/note follow `canSeeOnline`; invisible byte-identical to offline; wallpaper/theme never in room broadcasts; space member payloads carry ids/nickname/roleIds only; space member lists visible to co-members is a documented new rule (docs 611 today: "Community member list, announcement member list: owner/admins only"; fanout.ts:23-27) with a regression test added to test/accounts/privacy-regressions.test.ts; no online count for non-members.
- Uploads: bytes sniffed (uploads.ts:56-63) AND parsed (dimensions/frames/decoded-pixel budget); metadata stripped server-side; poster required for animated; per-purpose caps (avatar 5/8 MiB, banner 10 MiB, wallpaper 15/25 MiB); AVIF never for profile/wallpaper media; `requireOwnedMedia` FOR KEY SHARE inside the referencing tx; every media FK in the GC list and in scrub.
- Themes: enum ids + lowercase hex only (`z.strictObject`), never CSS/URLs (style-src allows 'unsafe-inline').
- CSP: no external hosts; same-origin `/livekit`; explicit `wss://` self origins for Safari; built-SPA Playwright CSP check in CI.
- Rate limits: profileUpdate 20/min, presenceActivity 30/min/socket, spaceCreate 5/h, spaceChannelCreate 30/h, spaceRoleUpdate 60/h, spaceInviteCreate 30/h, spaceMemberUpdate 120/h, spaceJoin 20/h, mentionEveryone 5/min, voiceJoin 30/min, voiceState 40/10 s and voiceSpeaking 20/10 s per socket, slowmode per (user, channel) server-side (bypass MANAGE_MESSAGES/MANAGE_CHANNELS), invite preview/join on `inviteLimiter`, discovery on a per-IP limiter; all documented in ARCHITECTURE 859-866.
- Webhook: raw body + `WebhookReceiver` signature (JWT with sha256 of the payload), 401 without echo, event-id dedupe, 256 KiB limit, mounted outside `express.json`/`apiLimiter` (app.ts:80-81, before :86), identity/`metadata.sessionId` cross-checked against `voice_states`; LiveKit API bound to loopback; tokens short-lived (900 s), `Cache-Control: no-store`, grants derived from bits under the chat lock and revoked via RoomServiceClient on mute/deafen/kick/lost access.
- Authorisation: 404 for non-members of a space (never 403); hierarchy enforced server-side for kick/ban/timeout/roles/mute/deafen/move; owner immune; timed-out bits stripped in `getChatAccess` and voice join; bans checked under the space lock on invite join; every moderation action writes an audit row; role editors cannot grant bits they lack.
- Mutual exclusion: mesh calls and voice are serialised by `lockUserBusy` + `assertNotBusy` (services/busy.ts) in `startCall`, `joinCall` and `voice:join`, always taken after the path's row locks (chat row; chat then call row for `joinCall`, calls/service.ts:336-337) and before any write; the unique index `call_participants_one_joined_uq` (schema.ts:641-644 → 409 at :576-577) remains the DB-level backstop for call-vs-call only.
- Inputs: NUL/surrogates rejected by `parse()`; dates via `storableDate`; names trimmed and capped; `permissionsSchema` rejects reserved/unknown bits.
- Account deletion: `deleteAccount` (account.ts:46-157) locks `spaces` rows sorted right after communities (49-62), includes space channel chat ids in `lockedChatIds` (93-98) and the conflict re-check (107-117); `registerAccountDeletionHook('spaces')` (hooks.ts:24-33; succession by highest role position then joined_at, deletion when empty; collects space ids for the `user:changed` targets hand-built at account.ts:149) and `('voice')`.

## Open questions

1. Canonical `PUBLIC_URL` for invite/profile links: enbox.dev (assumed), enbox.cloud or enbox.enfinito.cloud?
2. TURN relay to LiveKit on the same host: after the nft exception, does the router hairpin traffic to the host's public IP? If not, enable LiveKit's embedded TURN/TLS (5349) instead of coturn for voice.
3. `about` (140, WhatsApp presets, chat surfaces) and `bio` (190, profile card) are kept as two fields — confirm, or merge.
4. `@here`: counted as an unread mention for everyone (current design) or only for members online at send time (needs a snapshot column)?
5. Pins in space channels: 50 without replace-oldest (proposed) vs the current 3-with-replace contract (chats/service.ts:507-518).
6. `MENTION_EVERYONE` off by default for @everyone (proposed).
7. Space member lists visible to all co-members (documented privacy change) — confirm.
8. Ship 0005 (drop communities) one release after the conversion (proposed) or later?
9. Reduce-motion pref: three states ('system'|'on'|'off') as designed — is an explicit 'off' wanted?
10. Voice e2e in CI: run `livekit-server --dev` as a CI service (~1 min) or keep the spec local-only behind `E2E_LIVEKIT=1`?
11. Migrated linked groups: the `joined_seq = last_seq` rule for community members who never joined the group (privacy-preserving, D8) vs Discord-style full history — confirm.
12. Capacitor/split-origin builds need an absolute `LIVEKIT_URL` and CSP entries (`VITE_WS_ORIGINS`) — out of scope until a native build is planned.
13. Members removed from a linked group by an admin (`left_reason = 'removed'`): keep them out of the converted channel with a member `deny VIEW_CHANNEL` overwrite (proposed, preserves docs 608) or treat them like members who left (future-only access)?
